The '''2019–20 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team''' represent the [[University of Texas at Austin]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by fifth-year head coach [[Shaka Smart]] and play their home games at the [[Frank Erwin Center]] in [[Austin, Texas]] as members of the [[Big 12 Conference]].

==Previous season==
The [[2018–19 Texas Longhorns men's basketball team|Longhorns]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 21–16, 8–10 in [[2018–19 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish in sixth place. They were defeated by [[2018–19 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] in the first round of the [[2019 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2019 National Invitational Tournament]] as a No. 2 seed. They defeated [[2018–19 South Dakota State Jackrabbits men's basketball team|South Dakota State]] in the first round, [[2018–19 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]] in the second round and [[2018–19 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Colorado]] in the quarterfinals to advance win the [[2018–19 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama bracket]]. They advanced to [[Madison Square Garden]] where they defeated [[2018–19 TCU Horned Frogs men's basketball team|TCU]] in the semifinals and [[2018–19 Lipscomb Bisons men's basketball team|Lipscomb]] in the final to win the program's second-ever NIT Championship (the first was in [[1978 National Invitation Tournament|1978]]).

==Offseason==

===Coaching changes===

In April 2019, associate head coach [[Darrin Horn]] accepted the position of [[Northern Kentucky Norse men's basketball|Northern Kentucky]] head basketball coach.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.coachesdatabase.com/darrin-horn-hired-northern-kentucky/|title=Darrin Horn hired as head coach at Northern Kentucky|website=coachesdatabase.com|publisher=Coaches Database|date=April 24, 2019|accessdate=November 4, 2019}}</ref> Smart hired Luke Yaklich as Horn's replacement in May 2019.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://texassports.com/news/2019/5/31/luke-yaklich-named-mens-basketball-associate-head-coach.aspx|title=Luke Yaklich named Men's Basketball Associate Head Coach|website=texassports.com|publisher=Texas Athletics|date=May 31, 2019|accessdate=November 4, 2019}}</ref>
